name: Grade 9 IT Practice: April Week 6 - Sensor and RGB
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: A circuit part that measures light or another value for the program.
words.example: The sensor measured how much light reached the circuit.

words.definition: The value limit that decides when the RGB output changes.
words.example: The threshold decided when the RGB LED should change color.

words.definition: A value measured by a sensor.
words.example: The reading dropped when the student covered the light sensor.

words.definition: What you think the system should produce.
words.example: The expected output was a red light when the sensor value was low.

words.definition: Red, green, and blue colors used to make other colors.
words.example: The RGB LED mixed red and blue light to make purple.

words.definition: One part of a color or signal.
words.example: The red channel became brighter than the green channel.
The red LED alert warned that the sensor value passed the threshold.
